newsitem.title: USA: NY Power Authority to restart 780 MW nuke Thursday.
newsitem.headline: NY Power Authority to restart 780 MW nuke Thursday.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) will restart its 780 megawatt Fitzpatrick 1 nuclear power station Thursday and reconnect to the grid the next day, the state-owned utility said Wednesday.
The unit, in Scriba, N.Y., tripped off line Monday.
"We will begin the startup process tomorrow," said NYPA spokesman Tim Carroll, adding repairs to the plant were completed.
The Fitzpatrick plant was shut when a technician caused an electrical short, which in turn opened the generator output breakers and automatically shut the reactor.
"The current schedule calls for producing electricity September 20, sometime Friday," he said.
If startup tests go accordingly, Fitzpatrick will likely be back at full output early next week, Carroll said.
